scope: Independent standard-library Python geometry and planning envelopes; no Julia/DFTK context/QE/SCF/FFT; no historical original arrays

geometry.grid_loop_order: x outermost, y middle, z innermost; itertools.product(axis,repeat=3)
geometry.coefficient_selection: Enumerate integer G over a Cauchy-Schwarz-complete box, keep |B(G+k)|^2/2 <=30 Ha, no fitted tolerance
geometry.density_selection: |BG|^2/2 <=120 Ha; same requested hard/smooth sphere for fixed dual=4, no Nyquist boundary allowed
geometry.difference_extrema: For each Cartesian integer-G component independently, max(G_i)-min(G_i) is the exact maximum over all ordered same-k G-Gprime; no all-pairs arrays required
geometry.rounding_diagnostic: Report minimum distance to kinetic cutoff among all candidate points; use integer numerators for the reciprocal metric before multiplying by pi

qe_budget.scope: New independent dimensional allowances, not an implementation/translation of QE memory_report and not a rigorous upper bound or measured peak. Fixed before enumeration for both cases; actual native estimate and process-tree peak remain required.

rationale.all_k_wavefunctions: disk_io=low buffers multiple k wavefunctions; reserve two complete padded caches including an active point, not only a single k
rationale.solver: eight complex spinor arrays of four times 24 states at one k; exceeds default two-times-24 Davidson subspace plus CG/initialization buffers
rationale.projectors: four spin-expanded 72-column one-k blocks plus eight four-spin small coupling blocks; a planning allowance, not a QE projector-column measurement
rationale.fft: four full 24-spinor-band FFT tensors plus 64 complex fields; conservative relative to serial one-k/one-band operations
rationale.density: 64 sets of four real fields cover densities, potentials, NLCC, gradients and mixing buffers; not claiming 64 native objects exist
rationale.indices: eight 8-byte indexing/metric quantities for every padded all-k G slot
rationale.runtime: fixed 2 GiB allowance for native libraries, Julia/JLL launcher initialization, Python parser/capture and remaining metadata; no separate DFTK numerical worker

disk_budget.local_saves: 2*single_save per profile: original SCF plus full independent ordinary Gamma parent copy, retaining unneeded original WFC files
disk_budget.local_process_public_staging_allowance: 1*1024^3 per profile, covering bounded 200-iteration verbose outputs, XML/table duplicates, metadata and staging
disk_budget.external_increment: one entire additional byte copy of the new local saves/logs/staging allowance; no old archives included
disk_budget.preflight_required_free: estimated_increment_local_plus_backup_plus_restore + additional_free_reserve_bytes; compare before all four jobs and again before each start
disk_budget.scope: Same-filesystem conservative requirement; if archive is moved to a different volume verify each volume separately. No compression savings assumed. No previous archive read.
